signals.title: Diamond share up +1.6pp → 42.2%
signals.detail: 395,832,914 SPX now in the longest-held tier.
signals.framing: Post it — ~15,144,346 SPX just aged into DIAMOND hands (the longest-held, rarely-sold tier). Coins reach it only by being HELD through everything, not by trading — supply maturing into strong hands, conviction deepening. Diamond hands earning the name.
signals.note: Word it as HELD, not BOUGHT: the +15,144,346 came from a cohort aging in from gold (≈ gold -15,115,254), not fresh demand. "Held into diamond" ✓ · "diamonds bought 15,144,346" ✗.

signals.title: Holders ~39% underwater — and still not selling
signals.detail: MVRV 0.61: price is 39% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.52). Yet 61% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving. MVRV has slipped 0.7→0.61 over ~30d.
signals.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
signals.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

signals.title: -86% below its all-time high
signals.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -92%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
signals.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
signals.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.
